data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Agee was a goddess of age and the ancient. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'aionios,' meaning eternal, everlasting, or ancient. The name Agee carries the meaning “Age, Ancient” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Agee usually hope their child will grow to embody age, ancient and live with faith, good character and purpose.
